author: Mostafa Gawad / JUMP ANIMATION
title: Hiring Vector Background Artists
content:
🎨 WE’RE HIRING! – VECTOR BACKGROUND ARTISTS

JUMP ANIMATION is looking for talented Vector Background Artists to join our upcoming animated series project!

Requirements:
* Strong skills in creating 2D vector backgrounds.
* Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator or Adobe Animate.
* Ability to match an established cartoon art style.
* Attention to detail and good artistic skills.

Project Duration: 2–3 Months (Freelance).

📩 Send your CV and Portfolio to:
* jobs@jumpanimation.com
* gawad26@gmail.com

💬 You can also message us directly through Facebook!

If you’re passionate about cartoon backgrounds and 2D animation, we’d love to hear from you!

author: When the Silent Bird Sings
title: Hiring Comic Artists, Writers & More
content:
HIRING COMIC ARTISTS, WRITERS & MORE ↴

We’re looking for help with “When the Silent Bird Sings” and other studio projects.

These positions include: Lineartist, sketch artist, colorist, storyboard artist, animators, music producers, language translators, comic writers/editors, personal assistants, video/reel editors/promoters, content creators & more.

These positions are paid but we’re open to collaboration / internships.

If you meet the requirements listed, then please send a *PROFESSIONAL* email to: whenthesilentbirdsings@gmail.com with the following information: Name, general location, Position applying for, Resume/Portfolio..., Rate per panel & for 60 panels, Rates for services, Turnaround Time, Programs / Software used, Preferred Payment Method (PayPal), Other notable experience. *NO DEADLINE, ROLLING APPLICATION ACCEPTANCE* ABSOLUTELY NO AI USE.

author: young.onion
title: Hiring Kawaii Artists for Stationery Collection
content:
🎨 WE ARE HIRING KAWAII ARTISTS! ✨🐾

Calling all creators of all things cute, pastel, and absolutely adorable! We are on the lookout for talented artists to bring their kawaii magic to our upcoming stationery collection!

If you love drawing chubby characters, happy little stationery, and sweet pastel doodles, we want to see your work! From journals and stickers to washi tapes and pens.

How to apply:
1️⃣ Make sure you're following us [@young.onion]!
2️⃣ Drop a comment below with your favorite emoji and tag an artist friend!
3️⃣ Send us a DM with a link to your portfolio or fill out the application form in our bio!
You can also mail us info@youngonion.in
